observations: body L1: the end of the Latin rendering of Pseudo-Proclus, begun on p. XVIII; the addendum to p. lxxviii and 297 continues to L19.

body L2-L35: «Vettius Valens», «Boll», «Palchi», «Firmicus Maternus», «Bardesanes», «Suter», «Steinschneider», «Gemino», «al-Bīrūnī» (L23, L32), «al-Mas‘ūdī», «Gemini» and «Fr. Boll» are letter-spaced.
body L18, L34, L35: paragraphs beginning inside the entries, set from the paragraph indent of the hanging lines.
body L20: the addendum to p. lxxviii and 301 begins at the margin, «lxxviii» in small capitals.

body L2-L8: the κ of the Greek is printed in the open form of this type (ϰ). The rough breathing of «ὑποτάξωμεν» (L2) and of «ἑκάστου» (L3) is joined to its letter. The numeral «εʹ» (L7) has its stroke printed like an apostrophe; it is transcribed with the Greek numeral sign. The final ι of «βούλεται» (L5) prints broken, like an exclamation mark.

body L14-L16: the Syriac of Bardesanes is printed in a West Syriac (Serto) type without vowels; the edition sets it in an Estrangela type. The first word, «ܩܪ̈ܝܢ», ends L14 at the right margin; L15 holds Syriac only and fills the measure in the print (the edition sets it from the indent); the last two words begin L16, beside the guillemet. The colon after «ܕܒܒܠ» is printed as a Latin colon.

body L14-L16: the two dots of the plural stand where printed: on the rēsh of «ܩܪ̈ܝܢ» and «ܣܥܪ̈ܝܢ», over the bēth of «ܟܬܒ̈ܐ» and «ܕܒ̈ܢܝܢܫܐ», over the kāph of «ܕܟ̈ܠܕܝܐ» and «ܟܘܟ̈ܒܐ», over the mīm of «ܒܡ̈ܘܙܓܝܗܘܢ» and over the yōdh of «ܝ̈ܠܪܐ»; «ܗ̇ܢܘܢ» has a dot over the hē. In «ܝ̈ܠܪܐ» the letter after the lāmadh has a dot above it and none below, as a rēsh; the dālath of «ܕܟ̈ܠܕܝܐ» (L15) has its dot below.
body L16: a mark like a raised comma follows the last Syriac word, at the left end of the Syriac.
body L27: «signorum. ... Et»: the omission is marked by three spaced dots after the stop.

body L32-L33: «وحُكي» has the ḍamma and the dots of the final yā’, «وحَكَى» the two fatḥas and the final yā’ without dots; each is set inside the Latin line as printed. The print sets these two lines farther apart (16.0 and 16.1 pt below the lines above them, against about 13.9 pt elsewhere on the page).
body L38: «Albirūni» has the macron on the u only.
body: the dashes measure 10.0-10.3 pt (L9, L12); the hyphens 2.4-3.6 pt.
body: marks in the left margin, from the gutter of the scanned book, and a speck before «Arabicam» (L22) are not part of the print of this page and are not transcribed.

notes_left L1-L6, notes_right L1-L6: note 1 runs from the left column into the right, with a thin rule between the columns. «C. Manitius» (notes_left L2), «Gemini» (divided «Ge-», «mini») and «Gherardo Cremonensi» are letter-spaced; «C. Manitius» on notes_left L5 is italic, within the title. «xx» (notes_right L4) is in small capitals.
notes_right L1-L2: the δ of «Ποσειδωνίου» prints broken, like a ζ, as on p. XIV; the grave of «περὶ» is joined to its ι.
notes_left L6: the closing parenthesis after «252» prints thin.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
